title: Caption-aware overwrite move and paste
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Overwrite move and overwrite paste with captions no longer leave a dangling clipLocal host after the destination is carved. Uniquely covered destination cues rebind to a remnant; otherwise the whole cue stays at its authored times as an absolute remnant with the same text. Later content is not shifted.

A followed cue on a moving clip still follows the host. If it would occupy the same times as a dest remnant, the command is whole-group CAPTION_OVERLAP. Overwrite paste may rebind a uniquely covered dest cue onto the pasted clip. A source-anchored cue whose window is uncovered or cropped remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND. Captions do not enter the internal clipboard.

A real UI path imports AV, extracts persistent audio, splits, adds left / carved-interval / remnant cues, sets Collision mode overwrite, commits a multi-select move, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

Already-delivered LiftClips/Cut, MoveClip, DeleteClip, TrimClip, insert-move leave-gap, includeLinks=false, field-aware invert, split/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. I-005 and I-010 stay partial.
